ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (11) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Land-tenure vocabulary is kept literal, as in the 30 January file: «земля» (zemlya) is 'land' in the property sense, «собственность» (sobstvennost') 'property', and «владеть» (vladet') 'hold'; «аренда» (arenda) is 'lease' and «рента» (renta) 'rent'. Russian measures stay as printed: «десятина» (desyatina, about 2.7 acres) and «сажень» (sazhen', here a square sazhen, about 4.5 square meters); «изложил» (izlozhil, 'set forth') is 'Retold', as in the February “Buddha.”

Source observation: [7] «не в силах бы были, не работая на них; платить за них ренту» (ne v silakh by byli, ne rabotaya na nikh; platit' za nikh rentu): a stray semicolon where a comma is required; translated as a comma.
